verdict.rationale: Apple documents a 16-core CPU for M4 Max and claims up to 2.1x faster Xcode code compilation versus M1 Max. A community Geekbench comparison shows it outperforming a 13900K, and another commenter treats M4 Max as the multi-core benchmark leader. One commenter questions whether Geekbench submissions are trustworthy, but that is general skepticism rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented boost/clock behavior and performance/efficiency core split, rigorous independent multi-core or compile benchmarks beyond a single Geekbench link.
